content.description: CryptoCultures is a unique NFT project running on the Cardano Blockchain, representing a variety of cultures throughout the project and bringing the world together in one place. +10% of the entire earnings are being donated to cultures in need around the world, to help out the ones who need it the most. We want to build a strong community and give back to those who support the project and believe in it.
